notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Minor fixes to a few bugs, in particular order cards that activated units incorrectly (or did not activate the maximum number).

Games in progress will not be affected by the update (and can therefore be continued), but to benefit from the fixes, it is necessary to start a new game.

Apart from these small corrections, the Dien Bien Phu designer remains focused on work for the huge NATO update.
Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: Dien Bien Phu first post-release update
